lines.text: Since last time, how is the low back?
Since last time it has been sore after long shifts at work.
Sorry, don't write this down, but my manager has been a nightmare lately.
Of course. Any tingling down the legs?
Some tingling in the left calf when I stand too long.
Wait, I need to sit down, my back is locking up.
Take your time. When you're ready I'll do some massage through the lower back.
And I'll send you some exercises for the calf.
